visual.issue: Hardcoded Tailwind color classes: 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 text-emerald-300' used for success-state rows instead of design-system tokens
Hardcoded 'border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/5 text-rose-300' for failure rows — no ds-token equivalent
Hardcoded 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5 text-amber-300' for warning/alert rows — no ds-token equivalent
Hardcoded 'border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/5 text-sky-300' for CostIncurred rows — no ds-token equivalent
'text-emerald-400' hardcoded on the bolt icon in the heading — should use a semantic token
Icon container div (kind icon per row) has no aria-label; icon-only rendering with no accessible text for screen readers
Refresh button uses Icon.alert (triangle-warning icon) as loading spinner — misleading icon semantics; no aria-label distinguishing 'loading' vs 'refresh' state
Loading spinner uses Icon.alert (same warning icon) with animate-spin — semantically wrong icon for a loading state; no aria-busy or role='status'
Refresh is the only action but styled identically to filter controls (same visual weight as selects); no primary-action prominence
